description: Return a setup snippet for openai, anthropic, google-genai, vercel-ai-sdk, mastra, openai-agents, or langgraph. Provider clients are wrapped with withSpurvik. The Vercel AI SDK snippet passes spurvikMiddleware to wrapLanguageModel. The Mastra snippet calls withSpurvikMastra. The OpenAI Agents snippet calls withSpurvikModelProvider. The LangGraph snippet calls withSpurvikLangGraph and spurvikInterrupt. The snippet is built from the installed spurvik exports (`spurvik` or `spurvik-sdk`, including `spurvik/ai`, `spurvik/langgraph`, `spurvik/mastra`, and `spurvik/openai-agents`). The disclosure label is a separate React client snippet that imports `spurvik/react`. `riskTier` is a sample value. Set your own classification (as provider or deployer); Spurvik does not classify your use case. The SDK logs the call and attaches an HMAC receipt. It does not mark content. Also accepts react, python, fastapi, langchain, pydantic-ai (zero-dependency Python 3.10+ helper at https://spurvik.com/r/spurvik_guard.py), shopify (.liquid Online Store 2.0 section), wordpress (plugin .zip & wp_footer), webflow, and html.
name: spurvik_setup_snippet
